scope.summary: grant_scope_match libFuzzer timeouts fixed by upgrading sqlparser 0.62 -> 0.63 (upstream fix for exponential compound-field backtracking, apache/datafusion-sqlparser-rs #2344); both CI reproducers committed byte-for-byte as release-timed regression tests; all fuzz workspaces' lockfiles moved to 0.63.
out_of_scope: The workspace Cargo.lock and crates/oraclemcp/Cargo.toml also carry the 0.63 bump (15fb0577) but are excluded from the clean-tree scope because another agent has unrelated uncommitted edits in them.
No algorithmic change in oraclemcp's own guard code: the super-linear path was inside sqlparser's parse_compound_expr.

entry_points.name: fuzz workspaces locked build (orchestrator)
entry_points.trace: cargo +nightly-2026-05-11 check --locked --manifest-path crates/oraclemcp-{auth,config}/fuzz/Cargo.toml -> Finished (after 32f1c1c7). CI on 32f1c1c7: success.

limitations: Gate prepush on 66a91448 passed 15/15 but did not cover the separate auth/config fuzz workspaces; CI caught the stale lockfiles and 32f1c1c7 fixed them. The swarm gate now has a fuzz-locks step.

The scoped_grant_matcher check() helper moved from match_statement(parse(sql)) to match_sql(sql); a proptest's bare is_err() could pass vacuously if a fixed statement stopped parsing. The verifier's differential shows identical verdicts for those statements on both parser versions.
